body.condition: For every law under consideration and almost every admissible realized query \(z_0\) under its marginal query law, every conditional marginal law of \(X_{st}\) given \(z_0\) has a Lebesgue density \(f_{st\mid z_0}\) on \([0,1]^d\) satisfying \(c_X\le f_{st\mid z_0}(x)\le C_X\) for Lebesgue-almost-every \(x\); the same constants apply uniformly over laws, cohorts, dates, and such query values.

novel.justification: The density restriction is explicitly conditional on the realized event query, holds only at marginal-almost-every query for a panel law, and uses common constants.  The named fixed-query class evaluates the same restriction pointwise without selecting null versions.
